Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents an inventory item at Wara Wara Stores.

id.description: Unique custom SKU matching the document ID, e.g., 'WWS-001'

category.description: Product category, e.g., Tools, Plumbing, Electrical, etc.

current_stock.description: Available stock on the shelves ready for purchase

total_offloaded.description: Historical accumulated stock received at offloading

unit_price.description: Price per unit in Sierra Leonean Leone (SLe)

StaffProfile.title: StaffProfile
StaffProfile.description: Represents access credentials and permissions for shop staff.

name.description: Full name of the staff member

role.description: Auth role determining administrative or floor staff permissions

permissions.description: Fine-grained capability flags for staff users

Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: A transaction entry in the shop's sales ledger.

staff_id.description: UID of the staff who processed this sale

reference_details.description: Optional details, e.g., cheque serial or transaction reference

items.description: List of products and quantities sold in this transaction

TBCRegistry.title: TBCRegistry
TBCRegistry.description: To Be Collected (TBC) registry record for products paid for but not yet collected.

collected_by.description: Optionally populated when status becomes collected

collected_at.description: Optionally populated when status becomes collected

staff_profiles/{userId}.description: Profile data and granular permissions for staff members

sales_ledger/{saleId}.description: Irreversible financial ledger of all completed sales

tbc_registry/{tbcId}.description: Registry tracking paid products slated for later collection
